titulo: Microsoft-Owned GitHub Stuns Followers as It Celebrates AnyPS5 Repo in Now-Deleted Tweet
texto: In a post that’s since been deleted, Microsoft-owned code and software collaboration site GitHub celebrated the AnyPS5 repo “passing 58k stars” from users on the platform as a result of the launch of GTA 6. GitHub even told followers "Happy GTA VImas!" in a tweet that will almost certainly have infurated Rockstar Games, parent company Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox.
